issue.title: Land cross-repo turns without stranding their epic or core pin
issue.description: A single agent turn that changes both sase and sase-core lands one green commit per repo with sase-core-revision.txt already pointing at the new core commit, agents know host commits happen after their turn so they close finished work instead of deferring it, and the stranded sase-1ck.4.1 landing is finished.
